articles.title: Südsudan: Zehntausende Menschen fliehen vor Gewalt im Südsudan
articles.teaser: 15 Jahre nach Beginn des Bürgerkriegs im Südsudan ist die Gewalt in dem ostafrikanischen Land erneut eskaliert. Das Rote Kreuz spricht von einer großen Fluchtbewegung.
articles.image_title: Südsudan: Mahamat Hamid Abakar, 33, who suffered head and leg injuries during a drone attack on the vehicle he was traveling in near Um Baru, Sudan, is being treated by nurses at the hospital in Tine, Wadi Fira, Chad, on January 30, 2026. Most of the wounded crossing the border are victims of drones, which have been much deployed in strikes by both sides in the conflict. Since April 2023, Sudan's government army has been fighting its former allies in the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF). The war has killed tens of thousands of people, displaced more than 13 million, according to the United Nations, and triggered a humanitarian crisis. (Photo by Joris Bolomey / AFP via Getty Images)
